missing_candidate_claims: Material Volume Report: report volume of material in a given library at any point in time, based on new acquisitions, items on the shelf (checked in), and items out in circulation (checked out).

Material Volume Report category breakdown: break down material volume into categories including total items in library, number of holds, number of adult fiction, and number of board books; support other customizable categories.
Material Volume Report time-travel/historical capability: generate volume at any point in time (not just current) for historical comparisons.
System Capacity Interface: provide an interface showing capacity of all branches (high-level summary across all branches) with ability to drill down into individual branches.
System Capacity Interface sorting/filtering: support sorting and filtering (e.g., by region, by library type, by current load).
System Capacity Interface trends: show trend data (growth/shrink patterns) for branches to support long-term planning.
System Capacity Interface export: export capacity data to CSV.
Shelf Space Report: for each genre and format, compare percentage of total circulations, percentage of the collection, and percentage of total shelf space.
Shelf Space Report scope: run report per library and per system (and allow system-level and branch-level views).
Shelf Space Report date filtering: support filtering by date range (e.g., Q1 vs Q2) for shelf space utilization.
Shelf Space Report comparison view: provide a comparison view showing each library's breakdown side by side to spot outliers.
Item Transfer Utility: provide a utility for transferring batches of items between branches (mobile library, outreach collection, just-in-time warehouse).
Item Transfer Utility query builder and reusable saved queries: query for candidate materials and save queries for repeated use.
Item Transfer Utility manual selection: manually select titles from query results (e.g., via checkboxes).
Item Transfer Utility batch location update and pull lists/transfers mechanisms: change records of selected items to new location and generate pull lists; mechanism includes changing location field.

Item Transfer Utility revert/auto-revert after set period of time and/or based on criteria: revert items to original location after a set period of time and/or based on other criteria (time-based and event-based/status-based).
Item Transfer Utility preview before changes: show a preview of how many items will be moved before applying changes; confirmation required.
Item Transfer Utility permission control: limit transfer utility usage to specific roles (e.g., managers/admins/transfer coordinators).
Item Transfer Utility transfer history tracking: track transfer history (e.g., how many times an item has been transferred in the past year).
Item Transfer Utility printable transit labels: generate printable transit labels/barcodes for items being transferred.
Item Transfer Utility delay alerts: notify users if a transfer is delayed or has issues.
Missing and Damaged Items Report: provide reports of missing and damaged items per branch.
Missing and Damaged Items Report condition notes: include item condition notes (e.g., water damage or vandalism) in the report.
In-Transit Items Report: generate list of items in-transit for more than X days (X configurable), per branch and per system.
In-Transit Items Report merge: merge transit-to and transit-from into one report for ease of front-line staff.
Item Record Purging utility: provide utility and reports to identify item records to purge based on customizable criteria (status-based, time-based, activity-based, and combinable).
Purging criteria combinability: allow combining criteria such as (status missing for >6 months) AND (haven't circulated in 2 years).
Item status conversion report: provide a report to assist converting items from one status to another in batch (e.g., missing -> discard/weed).
Last copy report: provide a last copy report that singles out a library system's last copies to assist catalogers editing WorldCat entries; available per library and per system.

Delete volume entries along with copy entries and delete orphan records: provide a quick effective method for deleting volume entries along with copy entries and deleting records with no items attached.
Purging safety: provide read-only reports for identifying purge candidates; separate confirmation step for actual deletions; maintain an audit trail for all purges.
Deletions Tracking: count and track record deletions (item/patron/bib types) per location and per system for auditing.
Deletions Tracking fields: track record type, timestamp, user who performed deletion, and location of the user; optionally include status before deletion; track denied deletion attempts.
Patron report filtering and grouping: support LIMIT (filter) and GROUP BY (aggregate) plus combining filters using AND/OR logic; allow configurable age brackets.
Patron null handling: include null values (missing optional patron fields) in results rather than excluding them.
Inactive Patrons Report: generate list of patrons with no circulation or electronic activity in the last X days (X configurable).
Inactive Patrons Report scope levels: make the list configurable to different levels such as System, Home Library, County, etc.
Inactive Patrons electronic activity definition: electronic activity includes OPAC login, placing holds online, renewing items online, and accessing digital collections if integrated.
Inactive Patrons report handling of fines: track inactive patrons with outstanding fines separately; accounts need different handling.
Inactive Patrons exclusion: allow excluding certain patrons from the inactive report (e.g., do not disturb flags, VIP patrons, staff, patrons opted out of communications).
Inactive Patrons export: provide exportable format (CSV) to integrate with outreach system.
Report Queue visibility: provide ability to see where a submitted report is in the queue and its status/position (waiting/running/completed/failed).

Report Templates creation and modification with safety: admins can create report templates runnable as-is or modifiable; changes to templates must not compromise accuracy; limit which filters/display fields can be altered by non-admins.
Report Templates cloning: allow cloning an existing report template to create a new variant (distinct from modifying).

Fine-grained report permissions and shared folders: provide distinct fine-grained permission levels controlling who can create/run/clone reports; administrators can use shared folders to allow/disallow staff from running specific reports and/or running ad hoc reports on specific datasets.
Query Tool: user-friendly interface for designing queries against all record types; allow selecting fields, values from picklists, regular expressions via dropdown, and using Boolean operators.
Query selections display: show the query selections/criteria alongside results so users can see what criteria generated the report.

Canned/board reports cross-tabulation: pre-defined board reports with basic statistics and ability to cross-tabulate by terminal, branch, system, hour, patron age range, patron type, and patron location.
Real-time vs historical reporting snapshot/warehouse: support historical reporting warehouse and ability to acquire data on a given date or date range for historical comparisons.
Cancel scheduled/running reports: ability to cancel a scheduled or running report.
Report output formats: report output supports Excel, HTML, and CSV; CSV most reliable for data export.

Item record Last edit date requirement excluding last circulation: ability to see the last edit date on item reports, but only when the item is edited and not include the last circulation; current system combines these dates.
Staff login supports streamlined optional method (card swipe) and fallback traditional username/password; streamlined not required.
Staff login audit: system must track which staff member is logged in for audit purposes; card swipe should not bypass individual authentication entirely.
Role-based access control: user rights and privileges controlled through security groups/roles; changing role assignment updates permissions automatically.
Inclusion of null/blank fields in results: all nulls and blank fields must be included in report results.
Export to CSV for outreach-integrated reports: reports should be exportable to CSV for systems requiring spreadsheets.
Financial reporting: value of items report aggregating purchase price field for entire collection or portion and supporting filters by item status/collection subset.
Financial audit trail: maintain a ledger of patron payments including which charges payments are applied to, for reconciliation.

Compliance with retention/auditing: all reports and data archiving comply with standard accounting practice and state/county/municipal auditing requirements; enforce retention policies (e.g., retain certain data for 7 years per audit).
Deletions Tracking denied attempts: track attempted deletions that were denied for compliance and troubleshooting.
Blacklist candidate: off-topic personal anecdotes (e.g., coffee, pets, dinner plans) mentioned in the source text.
Blacklist candidate: nonsensical/irrelevant trivia or unrelated questions (e.g., restaurant recommendations, myths).
